_sources.listing: Google Business Profile, read in the user's own Chrome via Claude in Chrome (2026-11-28): 'Petersen Metal Roofing Services', 5.0 stars, 6 reviews (all 5 stars), category 'Roofing contractor', closes 6 PM, phone +61 459 026 908 (matches the sheet), no website ('Add website'). Drawn service area centred on Gunnedah: Narrabri, Boggabri, Manilla, Tamworth, Werris Creek, Quirindi, Coonabarabran edge. Owner post (Nov 10, 2026): leaf guard installation. Cover photo: black Colorbond roof on a house with copper-toned timber cladding. Review topics: workmanship 3, roof repair 3, timeliness 2, tiles 2, communication 2.
_sources.location: The sheet says Tamworth, NSW; the listing's service area is centred on Gunnedah with Tamworth at its eastern edge. Page uses Gunnedah, NSW with Tamworth in the service area.
_sources.services: From reviews: complete re-roof of an old farmhouse, Decramastic tile roof replaced with Colorbond, tiles to Colorbond, large Colorbond roof replacement, roofing and guttering repeat work. From the owner post: leaf guard installation. Owner named Nathan Petersen in reviews.
_sources.brand: No brand online. Taken from their Google listing cover photo (black Colorbond roof over copper-toned cladding) with scripts/sample-brand.mjs, adjusted by eye: primary = copper #9a4d27 (white 6.1:1), dark = Colorbond black #1c1a1b (white 17.3:1), accent = cedar #dba878 (8.2:1 on dark). Sampled from their listing photo, not an official brand; confirm with the owner. Concept mark (ribbed metal sheet profile) is original.
_sources.reviews: Google Reviews tab, same session: 6 reviews, all 5 stars; 3 complete ones copied verbatim covering different jobs (Peter Costello: farmhouse re-roof, Linda Fletcher: Decramastic to Colorbond, Shane Turner: roofing and guttering).

gap: No website: 5.0 stars on Google and a service area from Narrabri to Quirindi, but 'Add website' on the listing, so homeowners can only ring; there's no way to send photos of an old roof and request a re-roof quote.

faq.q: Can you replace a tile roof with Colorbond?
faq.a: Yes. Tile and Decramastic to Colorbond re-roofs are a regular job.

faq.q: Do you work on farmhouses out of town?
faq.a: Yes. We cover Gunnedah, Tamworth, Narrabri, Boggabri, Quirindi and the farms in between.
Yes. Leaf guards and new guttering to reduce blockages, especially for homes surrounded by trees.
